title: Office Break Room Layout Designer
description: Users design an office break room by positioning a commercial refrigerator and arranging coffee mugs on a countertop. The task involves placing the refrigerator against a wall, adjusting its orientation, then populating a counter with mugs at specific spacing intervals while validating architectural clearance zones and ergonomic reach distances.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive office break room layout designer. Load CommercialRefrigerator.glb and coffeeMug.glb using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: Create a room with floor (12x12 units, light tile material), three visible walls (height 4 units, light gray), and a countertop (long box, 4x0.05x0.8 units, wood-brown color) positioned against the back wall at height 1.2 units. Place ambient light (intensity 0.5) and two directional lights simulating ceiling fluorescents. Camera: perspective at (6, 5, 8) looking at room center, with OrbitControls limited to prevent going below floor. Interaction steps: (1) Click a 'Place Refrigerator' button to spawn the refrigerator at room center. (2) Drag the refrigerator along the floor using raycasting to position it against a wall. Validate it stays within room bounds. (3) Use a rotation slider (0-360 degrees) to orient the refrigerator, snapping to 90-degree increments. (4) Validate minimum 1.0 unit clearance between refrigerator front face and countertop for door swing space — display a red/green indicator. (5) Click 'Add Mug' button to place a coffee mug on the countertop. Each mug spawns at the left end. (6) Allow dragging mugs along the countertop surface only (constrained to counter bounds via raycasting against counter mesh). (7) Enforce minimum 0.3 unit spacing between mugs — highlight mugs red if too close. (8) Support placing up to 6 mugs total. Display a HUD panel showing: refrigerator position, rotation angle, clearance distance (updated live), mug count, and spacing validation status. Add a 'Validate Layout' button that checks all constraints and shows a success/failure overlay. Scale models appropriately so the refrigerator is roughly 2.5 units tall and mugs are roughly 0.15 units tall.
